name: Beauty Dish Glow Portrait
description: One soft circular beauty-dish key light, held close and centered, wraps the same identity-locked model in a round catchlight and glossy, luminous skin against a warm ivory-champagne studio ground rather than neutral grey. Glamour-magazine polish carries through every frame.
lighting: Close beauty-dish key, warm ivory-champagne ground
subject: person
prompt: a close chest-up crop of a solo, poised model against a warm ivory-champagne seamless studio ground, lit by one soft circular beauty-dish key light held close and centered that casts a round, soft-edged catchlight in the eyes, genuine visible skin texture at close range — real pore structure, fine natural asymmetry, faint peach-fuzz catching the light at the jaw and temple — never smoothed into a uniform airbrushed surface, a controlled, physically small specular highlight sitting only on the forehead, nose bridge and cheekbones exactly where beauty-dish light naturally lands rather than a broad synthetic sheen coating the whole face, true photographic light falloff toward the shadow side with a soft but real gradient, not a flat digital glow, natural color variation across the skin (a touch more warmth at the cheeks, cooler at the jaw) rather than one uniform tone, shallow depth of field with soft warm background falloff, the register of an actual retouched beauty-editorial photograph — high-end but still a real photograph of real skin, never a synthetic 3D-render or beauty-filter look, no plastic or waxy finish anywhere, no other people in frame
